note: CBA reports under APRA's APS 330, which has no KM1 template. All figures are the Level 2 consolidated banking group basis that APRA requires. Ratios come from the 'Summary Group Capital Adequacy Ratios (Level 2)' table and the Group Capital Ratios narrative; amounts from the 'Group Regulatory Capital Position' table; leverage from 'Summary Group Leverage Ratio'; LCR is the quarterly average and NSFR the point-in-time figure, both as stated in the Group in Review section. First column in each table is the reporting date. Cross-check: CET1 capital over RWA reproduces the published CET1 ratio, and total capital over RWA the published total capital ratio.
